notes: Create test frames now adds two more frames: one for clipping, transparency, blend modes, shadows, blurs, masks, gradients and image fills, and one with a full-size image background.
They use a made-up test pattern image (no client artwork), so position, cropping and rotation are easy to check.
testFocus: In a new Figma file, click Create test frames and send all five frames.
Use the table in TESTING-M2.md (Test frames section) to check what each item in the structure frame should turn into.
